victory.primary: Place all Cave tiles, then destroy tiles until 5 Crystal tiles have collapsed (removed).

setup.no-knight: If no Knight: leave Treasure cards, Event cards, Event tokens in box.
setup.omens: Put Omen tokens in draw bag

cave-tiles-rules.rule: Whenever you place Cave tile, draw one to replace hand.
On your turn, place Crystal tiles from hand before other tiles. On other players’ turns, Crystal first not required.
Open edge on Lit tile (including after reveal): must place Dark Cave tile from hand on each open edge (no Cave player: from stack).
Multiple reveals: fill open edges in any order.
May examine Dark tiles on map anytime; do not reveal to others.

phase.table: Count Treasure tokens + Crystal tokens on map → Omen tokens: 0→1, 1→2, 2–3→3, 4–6→4, 7–10→5, 11+→6
phase.using-omens: Discard Omen tokens to bag equal to cost. Any combination of symbols shown. Any number of times per turn. Unused save.
phase.hatred-past-plunder: Three costs left→right: first, second, third use same turn; further uses cost highest.

phase.growth: Choose tile from hand; place Dark adjacent to any tile. Crystal tiles first if in hand. Last hand tile placed → Collapse begins next turn.
phase.collapse: Remove 3 tiles per turn instead of placing. Track Crystal tiles removed. Order: touch one tile first, then two; Crystal tile must be removed if possible; Dark removed reveal for Crystal; Entrance never removed; tokens return; 5 Crystal tiles removed → Cave wins.
phase.no-cave-player: Each player removes 3 tiles at end of their turn during Collapse.

phase.rule: Place Treasure token on Dark tile without player piece or Treasure. If none, skip.

omens.omen: Cost 1 Omen. Move Knight, Gem, Treasure, Goblin, or Thief up to 3 spaces (per rules).
Cost 2 Omen. Wall between two adjacent tiles without walls; or move if all 3 placed.
Cost 3 Omen. Target: Knight −5 Grit; Goblins Tribe to 1 Pop; Dragon Sloth Wakefulness→Sloth; Thief loses upgrade.
Cost 1 Omen. Place tile / during Collapse remove tile / rotate / Event token / move top 3 Event to bottom.

treasures-to-knight.rule: Knight claims Treasure: draw 2 Treasure cards; Knight picks one; other to bottom.
Dragon ends on Treasure: may claim for Greed.
Tokens return to you immediately when claimed by Knight/Goblins/Dragon.
treasures-to-knight.thief: Counts for Omens until stashed; stashed no longer counts for Omens or map placement.

events.rule: Knight reveals Event or enters Event token: draw 3 Event cards; choose one; others bottom. Knight resolves.
Played Events removed; deck empty: no more Event tiles/tokens for remainder.
May examine top 3 Event cards anytime.

collapse-other-causes.rule: Wrath and Cave-In: before Collapse — Crystal tiles count toward victory, other tiles to bottom of stack, reconnect, fill edges. During Collapse — removed from game, Crystals count.
